hook_line: DIWALI CRACKERS COST MORE THIS YEAR

hook_stat.sub: Production drop at one Sivakasi factory this year

news_summary: Firecracker prices will rise 15% to 20% this Diwali as production falls in Sivakasi, India's fireworks hub, on a shortage of labour.
payoff: Same Diwali sparkle — about a fifth more money.
